name: pixel1-animation
title: Pixel1 Animation
description: A pixel page transition (row cascade). Click an image in the typographic intro and a grid of 8×14 pixel cells covers the view, swaps in that image's page, then clears; the pixel arrow plays it in reverse. Ported from the Codrops Pixel Transition demo 1, rewritten with Zepa content and Cloudinary images.
